checks: two existing identities cache and reload offline without network or wallet actions
failed receipt storage exposes no shareable receipt and preserves saved history
offline message receipt returns to the sender and survives reload without another message
duplicate and forged receipts cannot change history or create a receipt loop
an offline tUSD receipt updates the standalone wallet without confirmation or extra credit
wallet can resend the same receipt without starting a conversation or modifying money
a delivery receipt never replaces a conflicting-payment warning
receipt states fit both themes and small screens while identities remain unchanged
scope: Two disposable Windows Edge profiles with actual WebCrypto, IndexedDB, file import/download and offline cache. tUSD backing/conflict are fixtures; no chain transaction, funding, deployment or existing profile access.
